   Shallow NCA has 414 stored positions and shared hidden biases; summing three chunks then dividing by three yields the intended effective bias. Its residual path preserves input even with all tensors zero. Thus identity success cannot establish tensor dependence. The direct initializer retains only colors 0–3; this is an initializer limitation, not proof that every possible direct genome has that exact behavior ([nca_shallow.py:24](/srv/cellforge-inbox/research-20261008/source/src/cellforge/construction/nca_shallow.py:24)).
